text:
jordan: Kicking off Oxide POC perf thread. Prospect asked for acceptance criteria: 500 qps sustained, p95 < 150ms completion latency, and confirmation that KMS/HSM won't break their SLAs. Need a simple runbook + cost delta. Can ops/eng help?
priya: Noted. Recommended model: rdx-3b-quant for their throughput/cost target. We'll want a dedicated pool for predictable numbers. Payloads average ~300 tokens (response ~120 tokens).
eli: Quick note on KMS: per-request unwrap can add ~5-12ms depending on envelope size and KMS latency. Recommend node-cached envelope keys with KMS-backed root key to minimize per-request cost. We'll run both encrypted and unencrypted to show delta.
marcus: +1. I'll size nodes. For rdx-3b-quant and 500 qps sustained, plan a 10-node baseline for safety with warmup. Autoscale can be configured but customers want deterministic capacity for the POC.
jordan: Can we get a minimal load plan I can share with the customer? Also want a ballpark on pricing impact for encryption/dedicated.
priya: Load plan (proposal): ramp 0->500 qps over 10m, sustain 30m, include a 5% spike to 750 qps for 5m. Use Poisson arrivals and 20 concurrent clients to mimic real traffic. Warmup phase: 5m prefix-cache priming. Capture histograms (50/100/150/300/500/1k ms).
eli: Load command I'll use (smoke):
```
vegeta attack -rate=500 -duration=30m -targets=targets.txt | tee results.bin
vegeta report -type='hist[0,50,100,150,300,500,1000]' results.bin
```
I'll run two variants: `--kms=off` and `--kms=on` (with envelope cache enabled).
deploy-bot: perf-job-oxide-1769812345 started on dedicated-cluster-5.
marcus: Quick smoke results (local): unencrypted p95 ~= 120ms, encrypted p95 ~= 145ms. p99 unenc ~= 260ms, enc ~= 300ms. Throughput stable at 500 qps. Observed token/CPU delta ~ +12% with encryption when cache not fully warmed.
jordan: Good data — can you put that into cost terms? Also Oxide has a security questionnaire blocking signoff: they specifically asked about key rotation and audit trails.
priya: Cost notes: dedicated node baseline is ~$2.40/hr (example) per node -> 10 nodes ~= $24/hr. Encryption overhead increases compute/tokens by ~12% -> roughly +$0.15 per 1M tokens in compute (rough estimate, will refine). I'll draft a short pricing addendum for AE.
eli: Draft security answer for questionnaire item 7: "Customer master keys are stored in the customer's KMS/HSM. Redwood performs envelope encryption with customer-managed root keys; envelope keys are cached on nodes for performance and rotated per our key rotation policy. All key unwrap/access events are logged to the customer's audit trail. For Private deployments we can support FIPS-validated HSMs and hardware attestation."
jordan: That should address the blocker. Action items: eli to run full encrypted+unencrypted 30m runs and upload artifacts, priya to prepare pricing addendum and a one-pager on encryption costs, marcus to confirm node count/warmup script and share cluster config. Loop in ops if they ask for HSM/FIPS.
marcus: Warmup script (to pre-populate KV cache): `python warmup.py --prefix-cache 10000 --clients 20 --duration 5m`
deploy-bot: perf-job-oxide-1769812345 completed. artifacts: s3://redwood-perf/oxide/1769812345/results.tar.gz
jordan: Thanks team — I'll attach results and the draft security blurb to the Oxide SSO contact and push the pricing addendum. Will update on customer response. :thumbsup:
